author: Pablo Spiga
title: On the rank of Suzuki polytopes: an answer to Hubard and Leemans
statement_paraphrase: For every odd exponent N at least three and every group between Sz(2^N) and its automorphism group, every chiral polytope with that automorphism group has rank three.
accepted_result: The explicit marking is a chiral abstract rank-four polytope. Consequently the stated universal rank-three conclusion is false in the fixed source edition.
diagnosis: The source imposes Wilson product invariance on two vector pairs of symplectic pairing one, outside the stated orthogonality hypothesis. The normalized exact example violates source equation (13) with residual 28331.
edition_limit: No assertion that later editions have identical text; no priority claim, no claim that an erratum is absent, no journal-full-text claim.
